title: Introduction to Calculus
description: Single-variable calculus: limits, derivatives, integrals, the fundamental theorem, and polynomial approximation, with interactive diagrams.
overview: A deliberately bounded single-variable preparatory module: limits, derivatives, the mean value theorem, integration, the fundamental theorem, applications, and Taylor approximation. Its 28 planned hours prepare a learner for the analysis used in the systems reference courses. A full treatment of multivariable calculus, series convergence, differential equations, and real analysis is outside this module.
